oint is that every con ict has to be resolved, and that the only way to resolve a con ict is to refuse at least one of the two participants. Thus, as long as there is at least one unresolved con ict, say between Alice and Bob, we proceed as follows. Try moving Alice to the reject list and run the algorithm recursively to check whether the remaining con icts can be resolved by rejecting at most k − 1 guests.
